name: B10-0206/2024 (ECR) – The shrinking space for civil society in Cambodia, in particular the case of the labour rights organisation CENTRAL
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the shrinking space for civil society in Cambodia, in particular the case of the labour rights organisation CENTRAL
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Cambodia to stop harassing civil society groups, especially the labour rights organisation CENTRAL. It asks Cambodia to drop charges, end harassment and respect its international promises. It also asks the European Union to keep watching the situation and to consider sanctions and suspending trade preferences if Cambodia keeps ignoring human rights.

- No law changes; Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- Cambodia, its government and civil society groups like CENTRAL are affected.
- The EU is asked to monitor, consider sanctions and possibly suspend trade preferences.
